title: Why Kids Are Getting Smartphones So Much Younger
hook: Elementary schoolers are getting smartphones now.
closing: The unboxing age keeps dropping. Ask any 8-year-old.
question: How old were you with your first phone?

segments.say: By 2021, 31 percent of eight-year-olds already had their own smartphone, nearly triple the 2015 share.
The vast majority of teenagers already have their own phone, 91 percent of them.
Ownership among young kids nearly doubled in just six years, to 43 percent.
